rv.q: Dookin' Out is a laugh riot that doesn't shy away from dark topics and manages to cover a lot of ground in just an hour.
Entertaining comedy about assisted dying and OnlyFans
Werenowska’s play perfectly captures the abstract and sometimes visionary quality of the ideas about love, society and sexuality that Lawrence explores in his novel.

cn.t: Critics praise this darkly comic Scottish play about assisted dying for balancing serious themes with sharp humor. Strong performances and witty dialogue earn solid four-star reviews.
